description: Flashtalking OneTag Spotlight containers on servedby.flashtalking.com/container/{advertiserId};{spotlightId};{spotlightGroupId};. The three IDs ride in the path. Tealium documents that generated snippet shape. Other Flashtalking hosts are not contracted.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: It is the Flashtalking advertiser ID. Tealium documents it as the number just after /container/ in the generated snippet.
params.fix_hint: Copy the OneTag from Flashtalking so the path is /container/{advertiserId};{spotlightId};{spotlightGroupId};.

params.name: spotlight_id
params.description: It is the Spotlight ID. Tealium documents it as the number just after the advertiser ID.
params.fix_hint: Keep the second semicolon-delimited integer from the generated OneTag.

params.name: spotlight_group_id
params.description: It is the Spotlight Group ID. Tealium documents it as the number just after the Spotlight ID.
params.fix_hint: Keep the third semicolon-delimited integer from the generated OneTag.
